title: I don't care if my bots are good

messages.text: most of the time i dont care if my bots are "good". theres plenty of bots ive made that just dont do well, theres no userbase for those types of bots. i know it doesnt reflect on me as a creator.
I just aim to get things out of my head. I'm here to scratch my creative itch.
i figure its a hobby. hobbies may cost money and get zero monetary ROI. would it be nice to get some sort of credit for creating a bot? sure.
for now i enjoy it, when i get tired of it ill stop. easy peasy
yall ever get a review that lowkey almost brings you to tears with how nice it is? my motivation to build bots just shot through the ROOF

what would be valuable to me would be feedback on my bots. i have no idea how to incentivize users to share feedback on my bots that is actually constructive and meaningful... the feedback i get (especially a thumbs down with no comment) is so unhelpful.
i dont care about leaderboards or whatever but i do care about creating bots that people enjoy using
i do enjoy going through the library and seeing how everyones mind works! just please no more json... my mind cant take it
naw json aint it chief uses way too many tokens for subpar performance
ive noticed some of my most responsive and liked bots are literally plain text formatting. considering going back to it tbh
ive experimented with plain text, json, w++. all the experimentation has helped me refine my craft lol just gotta take some time tinkering to find out what works for u
figured id ask here first but are creators templates like the secret formula to coca cola as in if they share everything word for word then there goes their status or rep?
theres actually a good bit of us who share our ways of makin bots openly
thanks, i see these bots with like…millions
and im thinking if everyone copied that their bots would be amazing for not only them but everyone else then it would just be a matter of distinguishing yourself by your imagination
copying a template is one thing, it gives you a how to, but your own creativity will be what pushes people to your bots
I spent the night making bots for some folks who dm'd me ^-^ but now I'm exhausted x.x it's 2am and we're still in the middle of the work week >-<
if a robber came into my house at 3am i wouldnt probably notice because i would be too busy making a bot
never heard something so relatable in my life
"yeah yeah just take whatever. shut up. youre ruining my creative flow"
my top 2 bots just breached 400K and 200K respectively. this just made my morning

title: scared to join the voice chat

messages.text: I was super scared to join chats and the voice chat when I first got here. I've never fully interacted with fellow degenerates so I didn't know if I would be accepted or disgusted but I learned were all people who get off to different things.
I'm glad I became friends with Foxxy and he pushed me to make my own bots and showed me the ropes of it and image generation too. I'd probably still be a lurker if not for Foxxy.
My first bot is still my most popular but my Toriel bot is slowly catching up.
